headline: FC Goa Fumes Over Bengaluru's Controversial Late Winner
summary: FC Goa expressed frustration following a controversial stoppage-time goal that handed Bengaluru FC victory. The dramatic finish sparked heated debate surrounding refereeing decisions in the ISL match.

headline: High Court Orders ECI to Restore Goa Family's Voter Names
summary: The High Court directed the Election Commission of India to restore the names of six family members to the electoral rolls after they were deleted during a summary revision.

headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat to be India's Slowest
summary: The upcoming Vande Bharat Express connecting Bengaluru, Mangaluru, and Goa is set to become the slowest Vande Bharat route in the country. Geographical terrain and track limitations along the coastal route contribute to the longer travel time.

headline: Retired Pilot and High Court Judge Finish Goa Ironman 70.3
summary: A retired pilot and a serving Kerala High Court judge successfully completed the grueling Goa Ironman 70.3 triathlon event. Both participants overcame physical challenges to cross the finish line in the demanding endurance race.

headline: 80% of Deleted Goa Voters Shifted or Disqualified
summary: Official data reveals that eight out of ten voters removed from Goa's voter lists were deleted due to shifting residence, being untraceable, or disqualification. The revision aims to streamline the state's electoral register.

headline: Sankalp Amonkar Inducted into Goa Cabinet After 4-Year Wait
summary: MLA Sankalp Amonkar is set to take oath as a cabinet minister in the Goa government today, ending a four-year wait. The induction fills a key vacancy within the state cabinet.

headline: CSIR-NIO Transfers Coral Monitoring Tech to Odisha Firm
summary: The National Institute of Oceanography in Goa has transferred its coral reef monitoring technology to an Odisha-based enterprise. The collaboration aims to scale up ecological monitoring along India's coastlines.

headline: Woman Granted Bail in Goa Overseas Job Scam Case
summary: A local court granted bail to a woman arrested in connection with a fraudulent overseas job scheme. She was accused of cheating job seekers with false promises of employment abroad.

summary: Goa welcomed its first charter flight of the season from the United Kingdom, carrying over 300 tourists. The arrival marks a positive boost for the state's international tourism sector.

headline: Amonkar Fills Cabinet Berth Vacant Since Ravi Naik's Death
summary: Sankalp Amonkar is being inducted into the Goa cabinet on Saturday to fill the vacancy left by the demise of former minister Ravi Naik.
